build_accelerate_command_for_gpus: generate an accelerate launch command for a given number of GPUs and distributed backend
build_deepspeed_command: generate an accelerate launch command with deepspeed zero stage 3 for multi-GPU training
launch_llm_training: build a training command for an LLM model using LLMTrainingParams and available GPUs
launch_image_training: build a training command for image classification, object detection, or image regression tasks
launch_seq2seq_training: build a training command for a seq2seq model with optional deepspeed or quantization support
